entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • LSP misc-files: bad suggestions are made in context of naming a code element #78619
  • Adopt dotnet run-api in language server #78618
    .NET 10
  • Unexpected error for a user-defined conditional logical operator resolution on an interface #78617
  • Compiler misreporting CS0246: Type or namespace could not be found #78616
  • In Visual Studio 17.14.0 is missing the option to convert standard constructor to primary constructor #78613
  • [LanguageServer] TextDocumentIdentifier for external sources not recognized when client expands symbolic links #78611
  • Invalid code is emitted for a user-defined conditional logical operator #78609
  • DocumentationCommentId.GetSymbolsForDeclarationId doesn't work with method declared in `extension` #78606
  • Unexpected error for a user-defined conditional logical operator resolution due to nullable annotations #78604

Closed

  • Fix reporting use-site diagnostics for data section string literals #78172
    Next
  • MSBuildWorkspace: Cannot open project because the language 'C#' is not supported #78610
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-10615.136 #78607
  • RS0016 - value types - not all fixes can be applied #78601
  • unexpected ambiguity performing overload resolution from method group #34931
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix angle brackets in generics in hover #78621
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Namespace changes #78620
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Change AnalyzerUtilities to reference Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Common by project #78614
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [Hack draft] Convert /private/var to /var in document URIs for all requests #78612
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Support local functions in outline/breadcrumbs #78605
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • hotfix to fix restore and stop including bin/obj artifacts in directory with loose files #78615
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Track used assemblies of data section string literals #78552
    Area-Compilers, Feature - String Literals in Data Section as UTF8, Next
  • Ensure we pass unique binlog paths to each BuildHost #78599
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Give .NET Framework build task in sdk different identity #78584
    Area-Compilers
  • Merge 'main' into 'extensions' #78600
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • A bit of cleanup to StopWatchingReference's code to help diagnose an issue #78394
    Area-IDE, untriaged, VSCode
  • Reduce duplicated FileUtilities.GetFileTimeStamp calls #78321
    Area-IDE, untriaged
  • Ensure return local is the correct type for runtime async #78603
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Hot Reload: Handle document deletes #78516
    Area-Interactive, untriaged, VSCode
  • Update AnalyzerConfig.cs s_propertyMatcherPattern regex key refactorization #78530
    Area-Analyzers, Community, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Update AnalyzerConfig.cs s_propertyMatcherPattern regex key #78459
    Area-Analyzers, Community, untriaged, VSCode
  • Support consumption of binary extension operators #78594
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
